subcommands.name: run
subcommands.description: Invoke a test in Firebase Test Lab for Android and view test results

options.name: --account
options.description: Google Cloud Platform user account to use for invocation.

options.name: --additional-apks
options.description: A list of up to 100 additional APKs to install, in addition to those being directly tested.

options.name: --app
options.description: The path to the application binary file.

options.name: --app-package
options.description: (REMOVED) The Java package of the application under test.

options.name: --async
options.description: Invoke a test asynchronously without waiting for test results

options.name: --auto-google-login
options.description: Automatically log into the test device using a preconfigured Google account before beginning the test.

options.name: --billing-project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project that will be charged quota for operations performed in gcloud.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The configuration to use for this command invocation.

options.name: --device
options.description: A list of ``DIMENSION=VALUE'' pairs which specify a target device to test against.

options.name: --device-ids
options.description: The list of MODEL_IDs to test against (default: one device model determined by the Firebase Test Lab device catalog; see TAGS listed by the `$ {parent_command} devices list` command)

options.name: --directories-to-pull
options.description: A list of paths that will be copied from the device's storage to the designated results bucket after the test is complete.

options.name: --environment-variables
options.description: A comma-separated, key=value map of environment variables and their desired values.

options.name: --filter
options.description: Apply a Boolean filter _EXPRESSION_ to each resource item to be listed.

options.name: --flags-file
options.description: A YAML or JSON file that specifies a *--flag*:*value* dictionary.

options.name: --flatten
options.description: Flatten _name_[] output resource slices in _KEY_ into separate records for each item in each slice.

options.name: --format
options.description: Set the format for printing command output resources.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display detailed help

options.name: --impersonate-service-account
options.description: For this gcloud invocation, all API requests will be made as the given service account instead of the currently selected account.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of resources to list.

options.name: --locales
options.description: The list of LOCALEs to test against (default: a single locale determined by the Firebase Test Lab device catalog)

options.name: --log-http
options.description: Log all HTTP server requests and responses to stderr.

options.name: --network-profile
options.description: The name of the network traffic profile, for example --network-profile=LTE, which consists of a set of parameters to emulate network conditions when running the test (default: no network shaping; see available profiles listed by the $...

options.name: --num-flaky-test-attempts
options.description: Specifies the number of times a test execution should be reattempted if one or more of its test cases fail for any reason.

options.name: --obb-files
options.description: A list of one or two Android OBB file names which will be copied to each test device before the tests will run (default: None).

options.name: --orientations
options.description: The device orientation(s) to test against (default: portrait).

options.name: --os-version-ids
options.description: The list of OS_VERSION_IDs to test against (default: a version ID determined by the Firebase Test Lab device catalog)

options.name: --other-files
options.description: A list of device-path=file-path pairs that indicate the device paths to push files to the device before starting tests, and the paths of files to push.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: Some services group resource list output into pages.

options.name: --performance-metrics
options.description: Monitor and record performance metrics: CPU, memory, network usage, and FPS (game-loop only).

options.name: --project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project ID to use for this invocation.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Disable all interactive prompts when running gcloud commands.

options.name: --record-video
options.description: Enable video recording during the test.

options.name: --results-bucket
options.description: The name of a Google Cloud Storage bucket where raw test results will be stored (default: "test-lab-<random-UUID>").

options.name: --results-dir
options.description: The name of a *unique* Google Cloud Storage object within the results bucket where raw test results will be stored (default: a timestamp with a random suffix).

options.name: --results-history-name
options.description: The history name for your test results (an arbitrary string label; default: the application's label from the APK manifest).

options.name: --robo-directives
options.description: A comma-separated (`<type>:<key>=<value>`) map of `robo_directives` that you can use to customize the behavior of Robo test.

options.name: --robo-script
options.description: The path to a Robo Script JSON file.

options.name: --scenario-labels
options.description: A list of game-loop scenario labels (default: None).

options.name: --scenario-numbers
options.description: A list of game-loop scenario numbers which will be run as part of the test (default: all scenarios).

options.name: --sort-by
options.description: Comma-separated list of resource field key names to sort by.

options.name: --test
options.description: The path to the binary file containing instrumentation tests.

options.name: --test-package
options.description: (REMOVED) The Java package name of the instrumentation test.

options.name: --test-runner-class
options.description: The fully-qualified Java class name of the instrumentation test runner (default: the last name extracted from the APK manifest)

options.name: --test-targets
options.description: A list of one or more test target filters to apply (default: run all test targets).

options.name: --timeout
options.description: The max time this test execution can run before it is cancelled (default: 15m). It does not include any time necessary to prepare and clean up the target device. The maximum possible testing time is 45m on physical devices and 60m on...

options.name: --trace-token
options.description: Token used to route traces of service requests for investigation of issues.

options.name: --type
options.description: The type of test to run.

options.name: --use-orchestrator
options.description: Whether each test runs in its own Instrumentation instance with the Android Test Orchestrator (default: Orchestrator is not used, same as specifying --no-use-orchestrator).

options.name: --user-output-enabled
options.description: Print user intended output to the console.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Override the default verbosity for this command.

args.name: ARGSPEC
args.description: An ARG_FILE:ARG_GROUP_NAME pair, where ARG_FILE is the path to a file containing groups of test arguments in yaml format, and ARG_GROUP_NAME is the particular yaml object holding a group of arg:value pairs to use.
